title: HHS Announces Provider Relief Fund Reporting Update - Amending Reporting Timeline
titleTag: Provider Relief Fund Update - Amending Reporting Timeline
description: On January 15th, 2021, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), through the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA), announced that it would be amending the reporting timeline for the Provider Relief Fund Program (PRF) due to the recent passage of the Coronavirus Response and Relief Supplemental Appropriations Act.
body:
On January 15th, 2021, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), through the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA), announced that it would be amending the reporting timeline for the Provider Relief Fund Program (PRF) due to the recent passage of the Coronavirus Response and Relief Supplemental Appropriations Act. HHS has been working to provide updated reporting requirements that comply with this recently passed legislation.

For the full announcement, click here. For updates and to learn more about the Provider Relief Program, visit: hhs.gov/providerrelief .
